 Most recent Most popular Post published at 21:23 GMT 21:23 GMT 
 Man City 0-0 PSG 
 Emma Sanders 
BBC Sport women’s football news reporter at Joie Stadium 
 Kerstin Casparij was not happy at all when she heard her name being called to come off as a substitute. 
 She was one of City's most played and most valuable players last season and now the vice-captain is being rotated often.
 Clearly, she isn't pleased about it.
 Image source, Getty Images

 Man City 0-0 PSG

 On: Iman Beney, Mary Fowler and Niamh Charles.
 Off: Kerstin Casparij, Grace Clinton and Rebecca Knaak.

 Man City 0-0 PSG 
 Nia Jones 
Former Wales international on BBC Two 
 Greenwood knew what she was doing. She got back really well in fairness.
 She almost has to make this one, knows it's going to be a yellow card.

 YELLOW CARD published at 58 mins 58 mins 
 Man City 0-0 PSG 
 Alex Greenwood is the first name to go into the referee's book.
 Sakina Karchaoui was just about to tee up a strike on the edge of the box, but Greenwood comes in and makes contact, bringing the PSG captain down.

 Post published at 57 mins 57 mins 
 Man City 0-0 PSG 
 Aoba Fujino did brilliantly to chest the ball down and move clear of Jackie Groenen, but Thiniba Samoura has been everywhere tonight and she gets herself in front of the Japanese forward's strike.
 3 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 56 mins 56 mins 
 Man City 0-0 PSG 
 As things stand, Manchester City sit 11th in the league-phase table.
 That would be enough to qualify for the play-off to get into the knockouts, but it's a dangerous place to be in - they're only avoiding the bottom five thanks to goal difference. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 0 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 50 mins 50 mins 
 Man City 0-0 PSG 
 Good pressure from Aoba Fujino to steal the ball deep in PSG's half, but Thiniba Samoura redeems herself with an excellent interception to stop Khadija Shaw from getting an easy tap-in.
 0 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 47 mins 47 mins 
 Man City 0-0 PSG 
 Aobo Fujino flicks in a dangerous ball and it deflects off Emilie Osteras for a Manchester City corner.
 The hosts play it short before delivering into the box, but Khadija Shaw can only bundle wide.
 4 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:09 GMT 21:09 GMT 
 Man City 0-0 PSG 
 Nia Jones 
Former Wales international on BBC Two 
 I just wonder as well how much that Manchester derby took out of City, both physically and emotionally. 
 It was an intense one. It was a great game but obviously brought an end to their winning start, domestically. Whereas PSG had an extra two days of recovery from their last domestic fixture. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 4 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 21:06 GMT 21:06 GMT 
 Man City 0-0 PSG 
 It's already been better!
 Rebecca Knaak launches the ball up the pitch and Aoba Fujino runs with it to the byline, but the angle is too tight and she can only skew over the PSG goal.

 KICK-OFF published at 21:05 GMT 21:05 GMT 
 Man City 0-0 PSG 
 Right. Off we go again.
 Hopefully this half is more entertaining.
 4 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:04 GMT 21:04 GMT 
 HT: Man City 0-0 PSG 
 Nia Jones 
Former Wales international on BBC Two 
 You have to say it's Lauren Hemp who has been by far the brightest player on the pitch out of both sets of players so the more they can get the ball to her, I think the more damage she can cause. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 8 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'We might see a few changes' published at 21:03 GMT 21:03 GMT 
 HT: Man City 0-0 PSG 
 Ellen White 
Former England striker on BBC Two 
 There hasn't been loads of fireworks but I think it has been quite even. Both teams will be wanting to come out, especially Man City, home ground. I think in the second half we might see a few changes because they need a bit more intensity in their play and a few more connections, especially in the middle of the park. 
 5 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:02 GMT 21:02 GMT 
 HT: Man City 0-0 PSG 
 Rebecca Knaack's header - the final kick of the first-half - was Manchester City's only shot on target.
 Paris St-Germain have done an excellent job of keeping Khadija Shaw quiet. She's only had three touches in their box.
 3 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 What's going on elsewhere? published at 20:59 GMT 20:59 GMT 
 HT: Man City 0-0 PSG 
 We're lacking goals in Manchester, but there have been plenty elsewhere this evening.
 Earlier on, Juventus claimed a commanding 4-1 win over Austria Wien, while Hacken scored an injury-time equaliser to hold Paris FC to a 1-1 draw. 
 Barcelona are currently in action against HB Hoge, and the reigning champions lead at half-time thanks to goals from Caroline Graham-Hansen and Ewa Pajor. 
 5 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:55 GMT 20:55 GMT 
 HT: Man City 0-0 PSG 
 Nia Jones 
Former Wales international on BBC Two 
 Neither team really challenging the goalkeeper up until that last corner there but [for] PSG, so far so good. It's a tough place to come, away from home and City certainly need the win more than they do right now. 
 5 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:52 GMT 20:52 GMT 
 HT: Man City 0-0 PSG 
 Emma Sanders 
BBC Sport women’s football news reporter at Joie Stadium 
 I've been to better football matches...
 4 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 20:50 GMT 20:50 GMT 
 Man City 0-0 PSG 
 Rebecca Knaak gets a head on the corner but she sends it straight into the arms of Oliwia Szperkowska.
 And that will be that for the first half.
 Let's hope the second-half has a bit more about it.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 9 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:48 GMT 20:48 GMT 
 Man City 0-0 PSG 
 Emma Sanders 
BBC Sport women’s football news reporter at Joie Stadium 
 It's not quite clicking for City at the moment. Alex Greenwood shakes her head and has a conversation with Lauren Hemp after a wasteful pass flies way over her head and out for a throw-in.
